#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

long long a, b, c;

long long compute_gcd(long long p, long long q) {
    while (q != 0) {
        long long temp = q;
        q = p % q;
        p = temp;
    }
    return p;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> a >> b >> c;

    if (b <= c) {
        long long g = compute_gcd(a, b);
        a /= g;
        b /= g;
        cout << a << "/" << b;
        return 0;
    }
    if (a == b) {
        cout << "1/1";
        return 0;
    }

    double min_diff = 1e18;
    double ratio = double(a) / double(b);
    long long res_num, res_den;
    long long left = 0, right = b;
    for (long long i = 1; i <= c; ++i) {
        while (i * a > right) {
            left += b;
            right += b;
        }
        if (i * a >= left && i * a <= right) {
            long long low = left / b;
            long long high = right / b;
            double low_ratio = double(low) / double(i);
            double high_ratio = double(high) / double(i);
            double diff_low = abs(ratio - low_ratio);
            double diff_high = abs(ratio - high_ratio);
            if (diff_high < diff_low) {
                if (diff_high < min_diff) {
                    min_diff = diff_high;
                    res_num = high;
                    res_den = i;
                }
            } else {
                if (diff_low < min_diff) {
                    min_diff = diff_low;
                    res_num = low;
                    res_den = i;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    long long g = compute_gcd(res_num, res_den);
    res_num /= g;
    res_den /= g;
    cout << res_num << "/" << res_den;
    return 0;
}
